name: Timothy B. Scull
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Timothy B. Scull, an attorney with Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP in Denver, Colorado, helps clients address Intellectual Property situations. He also helps clients with Intellectual Property Litigation concerns.
He received legal training from University of Colorado Law School. He graduated from law school in 1996. Timothy Scull became licensed to practice law in 1996.
Timothy Scull was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2027.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
